description: This file defines the interface and class structure for the OCDM plugin, including class declarations, nested classes, and method signatures related to content decryption management within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: OCDM
classes.description: Main plugin class implementing IPlugin, IWeb, and JSONRPC interfaces, managing content decryption and plugin lifecycle.

classes.name: OCDM::Notification
classes.description: Inner class implementing IRemoteConnection::INotification to handle remote connection events.

classes.name: OCDM::Data
classes.description: Container class for plugin data, including nested System class.

classes.name: OCDM::Data::System
classes.description: Represents a system configuration with name and designators.

methods.name: OCDM::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided service.

methods.name: OCDM::Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: OCDM::Process
methods.description: Processes web requests and generates responses.
